cohort: 42 pregnant women diagnosed with COVID-19 in their third trimester of pregnancy between 13th and 29th March 2020 at 1 of 16 participating Spanish hospitals, and their infants
finding: There were no cases of vertical transmission of COVID-19 in infants born to mothers with COVID-19, and advice regarding infection control measures appeared to be effective at preventing transmission in the first month of life.
mod_finding: The measures to avoid transmission appeared to reduce exclusive breastfeeding at discharge.
